$comment: Package H: every geometry constant that shapes the strip or the sign, with the commit that set it, the photo it rests on, whether that photo was stock, what it was assumed to hold, and how likely it is wrong today. Ranked (1 = most likely wrong). 'status': verified = checked on a photo or on the engine/source; hypothesis = reasoned, not measured. Photo ids per design/strip/H/provenance.json; '08=62' means one exposure. Coordinates panel px, boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1]. Commit history: design/strip/H/genealogy.json (tools/strip/H/genealogy.py).

ranked.photos: centre: car3 G on 34, 37, 41, 42, 43 (OURS, BMW's sign seen through our window; registered from our own drawing). r 40: a whisker at (502.7, 645.3) on the owner's close-ups of our build (ours).
ranked.stock: the sign is an 'under' element, so ours-over-stock photos are valid for it; the radius choice rests on no stock measurement
ranked.assumed: BMW's red ring ends at r 41.5 and losing 1.5 px of it is invisible
ranked.against: BMW's outer ring radius is 41.1 (spec, 7 photos = 4 independent exposures), 41.0-41.6 (H, tools/strip/H/sign_fit.py on B's rects 08, 09, 17, 39), 41.5 (car3 G): every source puts it OUTSIDE r 40. The centre sources disagree by 1.7 px in x: 537.3 (car3 G), 537.4 +-1.3 (spec), 538.4 +-0.6 (H, outer-edge circle fit on 08/09/17/39: 539.11, 538.66, 537.85, 537.72; 14 reads 538.54), 539 (catalogue). With the window 1 px off BMW's centre, r 40 cuts 0-0.4 px of red on one side and ~2.3 px on the other of an 8-9 px ring: a lopsided ring. Before 3bfce09 (r 42) the window cleared the ring except ~0.4 px on one side. ON PACKAGE R's FIRST RECTS (bake/work/strip/rect/6x_panel_2x, same fit): outer centre x 537.25 / 537.99 / 537.76 / 537.18 (61, 62, 63, 64), y 622.21 / 621.89 / 621.98 / 622.85, r_outer 41.6-42.0 at H's threshold, r_inner 33.4: the x agrees with SIGN_WIN, but y sits ~0.6-1.5 px BELOW 621.3, so r 40 leaves ~7.5 px of red at the top and ~5.7 px at the bottom (of ~8.3): lopsided top-to-bottom. The two registrations (B's and R's) disagree by ~1 px on the same exposures, which is itself the point: r 40 has no margin for the centre's uncertainty.
ranked.status: hypothesis (the cause of the owner's asymmetry; package O tests it on 68.png, package ZL/R fix the centre to 0.1 px on the hi-res photos)
ranked.fix: the window must clear BMW's ring everywhere (r >= r_outer + |centre error| + soft), and the whiskers must be killed by the ring of black, not by shrinking the window
